{{< include ../_provenance.qmd >}}

> **Exploratory / archival notebook.** This notebook is self-contained and performs
> its own computation. It is **not** part of the standard render pipeline and does
> **not** connect to the targets store for its results.
>
> It exists as a one-off comparison of lognorm RNA clustering vs the SCTransform
> path used in the pipeline. The parameter choice (SCT) has been made and frozen
> in `metadata/project_config.yaml`. Run this notebook manually if needed; do not include
> it in automated renders.

Per-compartment exploration using **lognorm RNA** as the reference assay.
Each subset: NormalizeData → FindVariableFeatures → ScaleData → PCA → cluster → UMAP.

> **Note:** The targets pipeline uses SCTransform (`REF_ASSAY = "SCT"`), not lognorm RNA.
> UMAPs here will differ from the analysis report — use the SCT notebook for pipeline-identical results.

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(targets)
library(harmony)

source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))
```

```{r params}
targets::tar_load(proc_params)
targets::tar_load(excluded_genes)

REF_ASSAY    <- "RNA"
N_FEATURES   <- proc_params$n_features
N_DIMS       <- proc_params$n_pca_dims
K            <- proc_params$k_neighbors
pca_name     <- paste0("pca.", REF_ASSAY)
clust_prefix <- paste0("^sNN_pca\\.", REF_ASSAY, "_")

# ── Edit the grid ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
DIMS_GRID   <- c(15, 30, 50)
K_GRID      <- c(20, 30)
RES_SCAN    <- c(0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7)
INSPECT_RES <- proc_params$marker_resolution
K_UMAP      <- proc_params$n_umap_neighbors
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

SUBSET_NAMES <- c("hsc", "mnc", "stroma")
```

```{r helpers}
cluster_col_res <- function(md, res) {
  pat <- paste0("_res\\.", gsub("\\.", "\\\\.", res), "$")
  grep(pat, colnames(md), value = TRUE)[1]
}

# Extract lightweight plot data from one processed+run Seurat object
extract_run_data <- function(srt_i) {
  umap <- as.data.frame(Seurat::Embeddings(srt_i, "umap.nn")[, 1:2])
  colnames(umap) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")
  md   <- srt_i@meta.data[, grep(paste0(clust_prefix, "|^sample\\.name$"),
                                   colnames(srt_i@meta.data)), drop = FALSE]
  cbind(umap, md)
}

# Extract elbow + PCA data frames (before neighbour/UMAP)
extract_preprocess_data <- function(srt) {
  elbow <- Seurat::ElbowPlot(srt, ndims = 50,
                              reduction = paste0("pca.", REF_ASSAY))$data

  pca_emb <- as.data.frame(Seurat::Embeddings(srt, paste0("pca.", REF_ASSAY))[, 1:2])
  colnames(pca_emb) <- c("PC1", "PC2")
  pca_emb$sample    <- srt$sample.name

  # PCA UMAP (for visual comparison with Harmony)
  suppressMessages(invisible(capture.output({
    srt <- Seurat::RunUMAP(srt,
                            dims           = seq(N_DIMS),
                            reduction      = paste0("pca.", REF_ASSAY),
                            n.neighbors    = K_UMAP,
                            reduction.name = "umap.pca",
                            return.model   = FALSE,
                            verbose        = FALSE)
  })))
  umap_pca <- as.data.frame(Seurat::Embeddings(srt, "umap.pca")[, 1:2])
  colnames(umap_pca) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")
  umap_pca$sample    <- srt$sample.name

  # Harmony integration on sample.name — for visual comparison only
  suppressMessages(invisible(capture.output({
    srt <- harmony::RunHarmony(srt,
                                group.by.vars  = "sample.name",
                                reduction      = paste0("pca.", REF_ASSAY),
                                reduction.save = "harmony",
                                verbose        = FALSE)
    srt <- Seurat::RunUMAP(srt,
                            dims           = seq(N_DIMS),
                            reduction      = "harmony",
                            n.neighbors    = K_UMAP,
                            reduction.name = "umap.harmony",
                            return.model   = FALSE,
                            verbose        = FALSE)
  })))
  umap_harmony <- as.data.frame(Seurat::Embeddings(srt, "umap.harmony")[, 1:2])
  colnames(umap_harmony) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")
  umap_harmony$sample    <- srt$sample.name

  list(elbow = elbow, pca = pca_emb, umap_pca = umap_pca, umap_harmony = umap_harmony)
}

scatter_emb <- function(df, x, y, colour_col, title, guide_title) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]], colour = .data[[colour_col]])) +
    geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(title = title, colour = guide_title) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4))) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 7))
}
```

```{r run-all, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
#| cache: true
# Lognorm RNA preprocessing helper — mirrors preprocess_seurat() structure
# but uses NormalizeData → FindVariableFeatures → ScaleData → RunPCA.
preprocess_rna <- function(srt) {
  out <- NULL
  suppressMessages(invisible(capture.output({
    out <- Seurat::NormalizeData(srt, verbose = FALSE) |>
      Seurat::FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst",
                                   nfeatures        = N_FEATURES,
                                   verbose          = FALSE)
    Seurat::VariableFeatures(out) <- setdiff(Seurat::VariableFeatures(out), excluded_genes)
    out <- out |>
      Seurat::ScaleData(verbose = FALSE) |>
      Seurat::RunPCA(assay          = REF_ASSAY,
                     reduction.name = pca_name,
                     verbose        = FALSE)
  })))
  out
}

subset_data <- list()
for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  target_nm <- paste0("mpn_clean_", nm)
  targets::tar_load_raw(target_nm)
  raw_srt <- get(target_nm)
  rm(list = target_nm)

  # Preprocess once for elbow/PCA plots
  srt_pre <- preprocess_rna(raw_srt)
  pre     <- extract_preprocess_data(srt_pre)
  rm(srt_pre); gc()

  runs <- list()
  for (n_dims in DIMS_GRID) {
    for (k in K_GRID) {
      label <- paste0("dims", n_dims, "_k", k)
      suppressMessages(invisible(capture.output({
        # Preprocess fresh each run so dims/k differences start from the same input
        srt_i <- preprocess_rna(raw_srt)
        srt_i <- find_neighbors_clusters(srt_i,
                                         dims_i    = seq(n_dims),
                                         ref_assay = REF_ASSAY,
                                         k         = k,
                                         res       = RES_SCAN)
        srt_i <- Seurat::RunUMAP(srt_i,
                                  n.neighbors    = K_UMAP,
                                  nn.name        = Seurat::Neighbors(srt_i),
                                  reduction.name = "umap.nn",
                                  return.model   = FALSE,
                                  verbose        = FALSE)
      })))
      runs[[label]] <- extract_run_data(srt_i)
      rm(srt_i); gc()
    }
  }

  rm(raw_srt); gc()
  subset_data[[nm]] <- list(pre = pre, runs = runs)
}
message("Done: ", paste(SUBSET_NAMES, collapse = ", "))
```

```{r pca-tabs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 6

for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  cat("\n\n### ", nm, "\n\n")
  pre <- subset_data[[nm]]$pre

  p_elbow <- ggplot(pre$elbow, aes(x = dims, y = stdev)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = N_DIMS, linetype = "dashed", colour = "firebrick") +
    labs(title    = paste0("PCA elbow — ", nm),
         subtitle = paste0("Dashed = n_pca_dims = ", N_DIMS),
         x = "PC", y = "Std Dev") +
    theme_bw()

  p_pca  <- scatter_emb(pre$pca, "PC1", "PC2", "sample",
                        paste0("PCA — ", nm), "Sample")

  print(p_elbow / p_pca)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## 2. PCA vs Harmony UMAP — coloured by sample {.tabset}

Visual comparison of UMAP computed from PCA vs Harmony-corrected embeddings.
Harmony is run on `sample.name` for batch correction assessment only — it is
not used in any downstream analysis.

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r harmony-comparison-tabs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5

for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  cat("\n\n### ", nm, "\n\n")
  pre <- subset_data[[nm]]$pre

  p_pca <- scatter_emb(pre$umap_pca, "UMAP1", "UMAP2", "sample",
                       paste0(nm, " — PCA UMAP"), "Sample")
  p_har <- scatter_emb(pre$umap_harmony, "UMAP1", "UMAP2", "sample",
                       paste0(nm, " — Harmony UMAP"), "Sample")
  print(p_pca | p_har)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

```{r umap-sample-tabs}
for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
```

## 4. UMAP — coloured by cluster (res `r INSPECT_RES`) {.tabset}

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r umap-cluster-tabs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  runs <- subset_data[[nm]]$runs
  cat("\n\n### ", nm, "\n\n")

  plots <- list()
  for (lbl in names(runs)) {
    df        <- runs[[lbl]]
    col       <- cluster_col_res(df, INSPECT_RES)
    df[[col]] <- factor(df[[col]])
    centroids <- df |> group_by(.data[[col]]) |>
      summarise(UMAP1 = median(UMAP1), UMAP2 = median(UMAP2), .groups = "drop")
    plots[[lbl]] <- ggplot(df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, colour = .data[[col]])) +
      geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
      ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data = centroids,
                                aes(label = .data[[col]]),
                                size = 3, show.legend = FALSE,
                                label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"),
                                max.overlaps = Inf) +
      labs(title = lbl) +
      theme_void(base_size = 9) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  }
  print(wrap_plots(plots, ncol = length(K_GRID)))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

:::

## 5. Resolution scan {.tabset}

Pick one run per subset and inspect how cluster count varies with resolution.

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r res-scan-tabs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  runs <- subset_data[[nm]]$runs
  cat("\n\n### ", nm, "\n\n")

  inspect_run <- paste0("dims", N_DIMS, "_k", K)
  if (!inspect_run %in% names(runs)) inspect_run <- names(runs)[1]
  df <- runs[[inspect_run]]

  clust_cols <- grep(paste0(clust_prefix, ".*_res\\."),
                     colnames(df), value = TRUE)

  res_rows <- list()
  for (col in clust_cols) {
    res_rows[[col]] <- data.frame(
      resolution = sub(paste0(clust_prefix, "\\d+_"), "", col),
      n_clusters = nlevels(factor(df[[col]]))
    )
  }
  res_summary <- do.call(rbind, res_rows)
  rm(res_rows)
  p_bar <- ggplot(res_summary, aes(x = resolution, y = n_clusters)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(title = paste0("Cluster count vs resolution — ", nm, " (", inspect_run, ")"),
         x = "Resolution", y = "# clusters") +
    theme_bw()

  strip_plots <- list()
  for (col in clust_cols) {
    res_label    <- sub(paste0(clust_prefix, "\\d+_"), "", col)
    n_cl         <- nlevels(factor(df[[col]]))
    df[[col]]    <- factor(df[[col]])
    centroids    <- df |> group_by(.data[[col]]) |>
      summarise(UMAP1 = median(UMAP1), UMAP2 = median(UMAP2), .groups = "drop")
    strip_plots[[col]] <- ggplot(df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, colour = .data[[col]])) +
      geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
      ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data = centroids, aes(label = .data[[col]]),
                                size = 2.5, show.legend = FALSE,
                                label.padding = unit(0.12, "lines"),
                                max.overlaps = Inf) +
      labs(title = paste0(res_label, "  (", n_cl, " cl)")) +
      theme_void(base_size = 8) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5))
  }

  col_inspect <- cluster_col_res(df, INSPECT_RES)
  cluster_tbl <- df |>
    count(.data[[col_inspect]], name = "n_cells") |>
    rename(cluster = 1) |>
    mutate(pct = round(100 * n_cells / sum(n_cells), 1)) |>
    arrange(desc(n_cells))
  p_sizes <- ggplot(cluster_tbl, aes(x = reorder(cluster, -n_cells), y = n_cells)) +
    geom_col(fill = "mediumpurple", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct, "%")), vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
    labs(title = paste0("Cluster sizes — ", nm, "  res ", INSPECT_RES),
         x = "Cluster", y = "# cells") +
    theme_bw()

  print(p_bar)
  print(wrap_plots(strip_plots, ncol = 3))
  print(p_sizes)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
